title: The Lion and the Dolphin

full_text:
A lion strolling along the sea beach spotted a dolphin leaping gracefully through the waves. The lion called out to the sea creature:

"Noble Dolphin! You are sovereign of the deep waters, and I am King of the beasts of the earth. Let us enter into a royal alliance, swearing to assist each other whenever danger threatens!"

The dolphin agreed with joyous goodwill. Sometime later, the lion was engaged in a ferocious battle with a wild mountain bull near the water's edge. Being hard-pressed, the lion roared to his ally: "Help me, friend Dolphin! Fulfill your oath!"

The dolphin swam to the shallows, but could not crawl upon the dry sand to strike the bull. When the lion criticized him as a treacherous friend, the dolphin replied:

"Do not blame me, King Lion; blame Nature, who made me master of the ocean but gave me no feet to walk upon the shore. Do not demand help that lies outside your friend's natural power to give."
moral: An ally cannot help you beyond the natural sphere of his power.
